text:
marta: Heads-up — UX question: we need to decide how scoped delegation tokens appear in the Console and how routing policies pick them. Customers expect SA keys to be project-level, but routing/quotas sometimes require org-level affinity. Which direction should Console push?

kevin: My take — support both. Let minting API emit tokens with a scope field (project|org|custom) and attach routing metadata to the token. Console should show the token's allowed routes and a warning if the token is broad.

sachin: Strong +1 for metadata. We should tag tokens with route_policy and quota_bucket so telemetry and billing can attribute correctly. Without that, we can't reconcile per-route costs.

lia: UX suggestion: replace a dozen toggles with a single "Token scope" dropdown: Project | Org | Custom. If Custom, reveal checkboxes for specific routes (e.g., generation, embeddings, rerank) and a TTL slider. Default: Project to avoid surprising blast radius. :thumbsup:

kevin: Implementation note: what about conflicts between token quotas and project/org quotas? I propose precedence: explicit token quota > project quota > org quota. Console should show any precedence overrides during mint.

marta: Rollout idea: introduce /v1/tokens/mint-v2 behind a feature flag. mint-v2 supports scope + route_policy metadata. Console will call mint-v2 when feature flag is on; fallback to mint-v1 for existing flows. Canary rollout is required.

eli: Example exchange call (for the new flow):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tokens/exchange 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer SA_KEY_xxx' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"scope":"org","route_policy":{"allow":["generation","embeddings"],"deny":[]},"quota_bucket":"search-api"}'
```

infra-bot: policy-lint: token metadata 'route_policy: allow: *' flagged — broad allow lists require a justification field and an owner. Please annotate in the mint request.

sachin: Telemetry needs: token_origin, delegated_from_sa, route_policy, quota_bucket, and token_scope. Add these to event schema v2 so Console can facet usage by quota_bucket and route_policy.

lia: I'll mock Console screens this afternoon showing: scope dropdown, route checklist, quota preview, and a small "routing risk" badge. Can we also add usage graphs by quota_bucket? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

kevin: Yes to graphs. Also: define retention and PII rules — strip project display names from external-facing alerts, only show IDs where necessary.

marta: Action items: @lia create mocks and upload to design channel, @sachin open event-schema PR and add test data, @kevin write a short precedence doc and include examples, I'll flip the feature flag in staging and start a canary tomorrow. We'll sync Thurs 10am to review canary metrics.

marta: Oh and one more — add a small inline help link in the Console when selecting Org scope explaining quota implications. Saves support tickets. :point_up:
